title: Foreign runtime and accelerated execution
summary: Acceleration is an execution provider concern. ooRexx objects retain model identity, history, precision policy, evidence and branch semantics even when NumPy/Torch/native code performs heavy computation.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Foreign tensors/handles are not durable historical state.
Provider-local state is either checkpointable/value-exportable or explicitly affine.
procedure: Prefer Maths provider selection for numerical acceleration.
Use Foreign Runtime tensor/DLPack seams for zero-copy execution where safe.
Persist only portable model/checkpoint values through Storage Fabric.

provenance.claim: Provider-neutral numerical semantics and precision evidence.
